the development of a new method for the registration of MR images of patients with a meningiomatous lesion, and the application of the resulting registration to atlas-based segmentation.
the development of a new algorithm for atlas-based segmentation that is able to cope with the specific problems of MR images with space-occupying brain lesions.
the development of a new registration method that is able to deal with large tumors.
